decision.rule: certify only when every exact objective denominator and every shared closure control is independently recomputed as proven

nonClaims: The replay proves the 17 objective rows; backlog and release authority remain separate shared controls.
Runner publication alone is not approval; this verdict uses the 23-row replay.
Component quality receipts do not substitute for the exact 29-row replay.
Foundation replay alone is not final certification; the independent objective verdict supplies the terminal authority.

backlogCensus.nonClaim: Deferred items are explicitly waived into follow-up ownership; this does not claim that those bugs are fixed or retired.

releasePushProvenance.nonClaim: The bound release commit must remain an ancestor of origin/main; later unrelated commits do not invalidate its proven release surfaces.

independentReview.nonClaim: The canonical certificate consumes the independent verdict but recomputes its required dimensions and reviewer count.

legacyAuthority.retirementRule: Any missing, stale, contradictory, unreachable, unresolved, or unknown input restores legacy authority and changes this certificate to not-certified.

supersession.reason: The independent certificate this audit binds to was recompiled against observed evidence and the live remote and returned not-complete. Under this audit's own retirement rule a stale or contradictory input restores legacy authority and downgrades the certification, so the previous proven status and retired legacy authority no longer hold.
blockers: reviewer-digest-malformed: an unfinished review was recorded with the literal placeholder sha256:pending-self-digest
reviewer-output-self-reference: the second declared reviewer's only output was this certificate itself
reviewer-output-is-certified-evidence: the first declared reviewer's output is the release closeback it was meant to confirm
reviewer-input-digests-missing: neither declared reviewer recorded what it recomputed from
dimension-digest-unreproducible: the charter, freshness and objective dimension digests do not follow from the evidence they cite
release-digest-mismatch: origin-main, target-head and frozen-runner no longer match the surfaces this certification was granted over
supersession.nonClaim: This downgrade does not retract the objective denominators. Plan 3.0 17/17, Plan 3.1 23/23, Plan 3.2 29/29 and Plan 4.0 17/17 remain independently replayed; what is withdrawn is the final certification and the retirement of legacy authority.
supersession.restoreCondition: Two genuinely independent reviewer outputs, reproducible dimension digests, and a certificate recompiled against the remote at that moment, all recorded by scripts/compile-four-plan-independent-certificate.ts --mode write.
